proof_summary: Assuming the first claimed identity, the shifted values \(c_k=a_{3773+k}+1\) obey the Fibonacci recurrence; a modular Fibonacci computation modulo \(195318521017\) shows \(c_{249580073233}\equiv c_{249580073234}\equiv1\), so that modulus divides the corresponding two consecutive terms. Their gcd \(g>1\), and writing their sum as \(gq\) with positivity giving \(q\ge2\), equality of the claimed next term with the actual recurrence would force \(g+q=1+gq\), i.e. \((g-1)(q-1)=0\), a contradiction.
